w1.title: Worked Example 1: Solar PV Array Tilt & Pump Flow Matching
w1.question: A 500 W solar pump delivers 30 L/min at peak sun. How much water is pumped in 40 minutes?

steps.text: Identify flow rate Q = 30 L/min and time t = 40 min.

check.q: What happens to solar pump flow if dust covers 30% of the PV panel surface?

opts.t: Current output drops, reducing pump flow rate

opts.m: Shading or dust reduces photovoltaic current.
Regular panel wiping restores rated pump discharge.

w2.title: Worked Example 2: Lateral Line Layout & Emitter Spacing
w2.question: How many emitters spaced every 0.5 m fit along a 15 m vegetable lateral line?

steps.text: Given lateral length L = 15 m and spacing s = 0.5 m.

check.q: Sandy soil drains faster than clay soil. How should emitter flow rate be chosen for sandy soil?

opts.t: Higher discharge rate with shorter, more frequent pulses

opts.m: Long single floods sink below sandy root zones.
Pulse irrigation keeps moisture within the root zone.

w3.title: Worked Example 3: Jal Seva Water Audit & Community Maintenance Log
w3.question: Why do technicians open lateral end-caps for 30 seconds each week?

steps.text: Fine silt that passes the main filter settles at the far end of lateral pipes.
Opening the end-cap flushes accumulated silt out with water velocity.
Closing the cap restores uniform pressure to all emitters.

check.q: Which tool directly measures root-zone soil moisture tension?

opts.m: A thermometer measures temperature, not soil moisture tension.
